# dsh-plugins
English | 中文
Out-of-tree bundle plugins for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Each package under `plugins/` is a normal ins
tallable DSH bundle: it ships a `cordis.patch.yml` layer, commits its built `lib/` output, and can b
e installed into any profile with `dsh plugin add`. The plugins are community-maintained and are not
part of the DSH repository.
## Packages
| Package | Version | Description | Documentation |
| `dsh-plugin-tool-usage` | 0.2.0 | Records every agent tool call with redacted parameters and a rea
dable explanation, reports per-tool call counts, errors, and latency, and adds a live Web UI dashboa
rd (session calls view and a right-side live tool-call stream). | English · 中文 |
Each package has its own README with the full behavior, configuration, and privacy documentation; th
is file covers the repository as a whole.
## Requirements
- **DSH** `>=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0` — the range is declared in each package's `engines.dsh` and enforced by

DSH at install and startup. Verification in this repository was run against DSH `0.2.2-alpha.2`.
-
**Node.js** `>=24.9` for development (`.nvmrc` pins `24.19.0`). An installed plugin runs inside the
DSH host process and adds no runtime dependency of its own.
Installing a plugin from this repository needs neither a build step nor a DSH source checkout: `lib/
` is committed. Building from source uses the npm dev dependencies, or a DSH source checkout when `n
pm install` is not available.

## Verification
Each package ships its evidence under `plugins/<name>/verification/`:

- `unit-report.md` — build and test commands, per-file results, and the environment used.
- `e2e-rep
ort.md` — a real headless DSH process in an isolated `DSH_HOME`, with PASS/FAIL per assertion and th

e exact commands.
- `live-activation.md` — activation in a running Web profile, with live JSONL reco

rds, `stats.json`, and a real `tool_usage` report.
- `ui-activation.md` — the 0.2.0 Web UI evidence:
unit/browser-half results, the isolated real-Web-server boot check (boot graph + served client bund

le), the upgrade/refresh path, and the remaining visual-verification limit.
- `e2e/setup-and-run.mjs
` — reusable E2E harness with `--dry-run`, `--no-llm`, `--skip-error`, and `--error-only` modes; it

recreates its own isolated home and never touches the live `~/.dsh`.
- `ui-boot.mjs` — reusable Web
UI packaging check: installs the bundle into an isolated `web` profile, boots the real Web server, a
nd asserts the boot graph advertises the client half and the served bundle registers the three slots

ml`; it reads them in-process and never writes them to the workspace. On hosts where a child DSH can
not nest a sandbox, run the one-shot task with `DSH_PERMISSION_MODE=danger-full-access` as described
run the one-shot task with `DSH_PERMISSION_MODE=danger-full-access` as described in the E2E report.
## Design
`docs/DESIGN.md` is the authoritative contract for `dsh-plugin-tool-usage`: manifest, bundle patch,
runtime behavior, redaction and explanation rules, statistics semantics, storage, build, tests, and
the privacy/threat model. Behavior changes update the contract first.
## Contributing
Issues and pull requests are welcome. Start with CONTRIBUTING.md; for security problems, follow SECU
RITY.md instead of opening a public issue.
